articles.title: India’s drought-hit maize crunch pits poultry, ethanol makers in ‘me first’ fight
articles.desc: Drought conditions have caused a significant decrease in maize supply, leading to competition among industries for access. Poultry producers, starch manufacturers, and ethanol plants are all vying for limited maize resources, exacerbating the situation. As maize prices continue to rise, the poultry industry has expressed concerns about potential feed shortages. Industry bodies have urged the government to prioritize maize for food production over fuel use.

articles.title: CBDT mandates new disclosures for tax-free gains on govt securities
articles.desc: The Central Board of Direct Taxes has introduced new disclosure requirements for taxpayers claiming exemptions. Taxpayers will need to provide detailed information on government securities to qualify for these exemptions. Newly inserted Form 173A will require specific data, including securities value and interest earned. Taxpayers are asked to confirm the accuracy of the information they submit. This change aims to enhance transparency and compliance under the Income-Tax Act.

articles.title: Google resolves cloud outage affecting UK banks and websites
articles.desc: Revolut was one of the hardest hit, with banking services going down for many customers.

articles.title: Copper stays range bound as US tariff uncertainty, oil inflation risks weigh
articles.desc: Copper prices remained range bound as uncertainty over potential US tariffs and inflation risks from higher oil prices kept traders cautious. China’s copper scrap shortage supported refined copper demand, while record high US inventories and cautious buying limited gains. Goldman Sachs expects copper prices to average $15,400 a ton in 2027.

articles.title: UK government to make Jackdaw gas field announcement
articles.desc: The long-awaited decision about the controversial North Sea field is expected on Wednesday morning.

articles.title: Sudan army drones hit mourners and fuel market killing more than 300 people, sources say
articles.desc: A truck carrying people to a funeral and a market alleged to be supplying fuel to the RSF were targeted.

articles.title: In second visit within  months, Rubio calls on India to scale up US energy and defence buys
articles.desc: India and the US are actively working to expand energy and defence cooperation amidst existing tensions. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio emphasized India's potential as a crude oil refining superpower. Discussions included increasing energy trade and promoting the purchase of American technologies for mutual benefit. Rubio also plans to visit Reliance Industries Ltd's Jamnagar Refinery to discuss energy security.

articles.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Wednesday
articles.desc: Indian markets plunged on Monday as the Sensex fell nearly 900 points and the Nifty dropped below 22,900, wiping out nearly Rs 5 lakh crore in market value. Private bank selling, weak global cues and earnings uncertainty weighed on sentiment.

articles.title: Aerospace and military contractors raise 2026 profit forecasts
articles.desc: Northrop Grumman and RTX have raised their annual profit forecasts due to strong military demand. The companies reported record backlogs of $109.6 billion and $340 billion respectively. Sustained commercial aerospace services demand has also contributed to their growth. GE Aerospace, while performing well, has warned about potential declines in demand due to high fuel prices.

articles.title: Fed sneezes, but emerging markets aren't catching a cold yet: McGeever
articles.desc: Emerging markets are displaying surprising economic resilience in light of the Federal Reserve's tightening measures. Stronger fiscal fundamentals and high bond yields provide emerging market central banks with greater flexibility. Some countries are even considering rate cuts, which may not have been possible in the past. Investor sentiment is shifting towards emerging markets as they are viewed more favorably compared to developed economies.

articles.title: US stocks today: US stocks gain as healthcare stocks hit record high, oil prices fall
articles.desc: Wall Street's main indexes saw increases driven by a rally in healthcare stocks that reached record highs. Easing oil prices contributed to a recovery from the previous week's technology led selloff. Major companies like General Motors and Steel Dynamics reported disappointing earnings forecasts, while 3M and Equifax exceeded expectations. Investors are closely monitoring upcoming corporate earnings reports from several high-profile companies.

articles.title: Hilton to move stock listing to Nasdaq
articles.desc: Hilton Worldwide plans to shift its stock listing from the NYSE to Nasdaq, with shares set to begin trading under the HLT ticker on November 5. The hotel operator says Nasdaq's focus on technology and innovation aligns with its growth strategy as it strengthens its technology and innovation efforts.

articles.title: China's CATL third-quarter profit growth slowest in nearly two years as competition intensifies
articles.desc: CATL reports slower third-quarter profit growth as intense competition in China’s EV battery market weighs on earnings. Net profit rises 14.5% to 21.2 billion yuan, below estimates, while revenue grows 58.6%. CATL also unveils new heavy-duty truck batteries and plans to expand its battery-swapping network.

articles.title: Bereaved families could face 'unjust' tax bill after civil service pension delays
articles.desc: The chairman of Parliament's Public Accounts Committee says families should not be taxed through no fault of their own.

articles.title: Dow Jones| Nasdaq | S&P 500 | US Stock Market Today |Highlights: Dow leads Wall Street higher, investors focus on healthcare stocks
Rubio says India-US trade deal is ‘very, very close’ after Jaishankar meeting
articles.desc: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated that negotiations for a trade deal with India are approaching completion. He highlighted discussions with Indian Foreign Minister Subrahmanyam Jaishankar about energy security and defense cooperation. While tensions over tariffs and energy continue to challenge negotiations, both countries aim to deepen their economic ties. Rubio’s visit to India includes a tour of the Reliance Industries refinery and meetings with business leaders.

articles.title: Meta’s AI spending and Muse adoption set to test Zuckerberg’s strategy
articles.desc: Meta's upcoming third-quarter results will reflect its significant investments in artificial intelligence technologies and products. The company's revenue is expected to grow by 23.8%, despite intense competition from rival firms. Analysts predict a decline in net income, estimating it at $15.44 billion for the quarter. Investor confidence has increased due to positive responses towards its Muse personal assistant and new AI models.

articles.title: Oyo parent PRISM to cut IPO fresh issue nearly 50% to Rs 3,350 crore: Sources
articles.desc: PRISM is set to scale back its initial public offering from Rs 6,650 crore to Rs 3,350 crore in light of its robust cash flow and enhanced balance sheet. The majority of the newly structured funds will focus on repaying or prepaying debts. Moody's Ratings has adjusted PRISM's outlook to positive, anticipating growth in EBITDA. Notably, OYO's founder, Ritesh Agarwal, and SoftBank maintain substantial stakes in the venture.

articles.title: French bond yields near 24-year high as new protests loom
articles.desc: As ongoing protests grip France, the yields on government securities, known as OAT, have surged to a peak not seen in over 24 years. Both Marine Le Pen and Jean-Luc Melenchon lead polling efforts, presenting hurdles for any potential fiscal reforms. Such public demonstrations illustrate the persistent opposition any administration encounters while trying to enact essential reforms.

articles.title: Number of branded housing projects in India set to jump over 2-fold in 6 years: Savills
articles.desc: Real estate firms in India are anticipating a significant increase in branded residences by 2032. A report suggests nearly 25 ultra-luxury housing projects will be completed in this period. Major developers have partnered with renowned brands to cater to the super-rich market. The demand for these residences is driven by rapidly increasing wealth among high-net-worth individuals. This trend reflects changing consumer expectations for quality and lifestyle within the luxury segment.

articles.title: US Stocks: 3M lifts annual profit forecast on cost controls, price hikes
articles.desc: 3M has revised its profit outlook for the year, expecting a boost in adjusted earnings per share. Their quarterly revenue reflects growth thanks to the safety and industrial segment. Strong industrial demand and sales increases in targeted markets are contributing factors. Despite hurdles in some consumer areas, 3M is successfully unveiling innovative products while focusing on improving customer service and operational efficiency for sustained growth.

articles.title: US Stocks: GE Aerospace raises 2026 profit forecast as services strength drives growth
articles.desc: GE Aerospace has increased its 2026 adjusted earnings forecast due to continued demand for engine maintenance. The demand for spare parts remains high, which supports their financial outlook. Airlines are facing rising fuel costs due to disruptions in oil supply and are adjusting their capacity accordingly. Despite potential pressures on flight schedules, GE Aerospace's revenue from services is expected to remain strong.

articles.title: US Stocks: GM's core profit rises 22% on strength of pickup-truck business
articles.desc: General Motors exceeded analyst expectations in third-quarter earnings, driven by robust demand for their pickups and SUVs. The company reported an adjusted EBIT of $4.1 billion, marking a 22% year-over-year increase. Despite facing inflationary challenges, GM forecasts an adjusted EBIT of $14.5 billion to $15.5 billion by 2026. Additionally, a $20 billion stock buyback program was initiated to bolster share value.

articles.title: Government to review 2019 mineral policy amid new sector priorities
articles.desc: The Centre is initiating a review of the National Mineral Policy, 2019, to address current sector demands. A nine-member committee will review the policy to reflect recent developments, especially in critical minerals. The committee is expected to submit recommendations within two months after its formation. Experts emphasize the need for a revised policy to enhance India's mineral potential and investment.

articles.title: Drill, baby, drill: China turns the screws, India looks for own tools
articles.desc: China’s new export controls on tunnel boring machines (TBMs) have highlighted India’s reliance on overseas suppliers for specialised infrastructure equipment even as the government moves towards a $1.2 billion incentive scheme to expand domestic manufacturing. The proposed package aims to attract $1.8 billion in investment over seven years, but the bigger challenge will be building local capabilities in high-value components and machinery rather than simply replacing Chinese imports.

articles.title: Market Trading Guide: Federal Bank among 4 stock recommendations for Wednesday
articles.desc: Indian equities weakened amid negative global cues and selling in private banks and IT stocks, pushing the Nifty below 23,000. Choice Equity Broking’s Sachin Gupta recommends four stocks—Federal Bank, ACME Solar, Dr Reddy’s Laboratories and Union Bank—for potential upside.

articles.title: Chancellor rejects calls to raise Capital Gains Tax in Budget
articles.desc: Influential Labour figures had been pushing for equalising CGT and income tax, but critics have said this could drive wealthy people out of Britain.

articles.title: Marco Rubio lands in Mumbai as New Delhi, Washington push to close trade deal
articles.desc: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio is in India to enhance cooperation in energy, trade, and defense matters. His visit focuses on advancing the India-US Comprehensive Global Strategic Partnership and includes discussions on economic engagement. Rubio's earlier trip in May involved meetings with Prime Minister Narendra Modi and External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar. The anticipated bilateral trade deal aims to address tariff issues and boost market access.

articles.title: IPO bound Paras Healthcare raises Rs 652.50 crore from anchor investors as issue set to open on October 21
articles.desc: The investors included Abu Dhabi Investment Authority, BlackRock Global Funds, Eastspring Investments, Government Pension Fund Global, Natixis International Funds, Integrated Core Strategies (Asia) and Citigroup Global.

articles.title: China flags APEC's role as key for a challenged global economy
articles.desc: During the opening of the APEC Finance Ministers' meeting in Hong Kong, China's Finance Minister Lan Foan highlighted the importance of the APEC forum for promoting economic cooperation. He urged the 21 member countries to work together in addressing global economic challenges, stressing collaboration in sectors such as artificial intelligence, the digital economy, and green initiatives. Lan reaffirmed China's commitment to broad economic reforms designed to stimulate growth.

articles.title: French bond yields edge down, but investors stay on alert
articles.desc: On Tuesday, French government bond yields lowered after a significant increase observed on the previous day. Investors are remaining cautious as they await a crucial vote on the budget bill. Recent protests highlighted challenges in reducing France's large fiscal deficit, which impacts market sentiment. Meanwhile, euro zone benchmark Bund yields also edged lower as energy price pressures persist.

articles.title: What is the Budget and what could be in it?
articles.desc: Chancellor John Healey will set out his plans for UK taxes on 28 October.

articles.title: European stocks extend slide as French protests dent risk appetite
articles.desc: Political turmoil in France has cast a shadow over European markets, leading investors to adopt a more cautious stance. The STOXX 600 index slid by 0.27% following a prior drop of 0.8%. Widespread protests have intensified economic strife alongside mounting government debt. Amidst this unrest, OVHcloud, a French cloud services provider, reported robust revenue growth and its first positive levered free cash flow.

articles.title: EAAA India Alternatives to float Rs 1,200-cr IPO on Oct 26
articles.desc: EAAA India Alternatives Ltd will open its initial public offering worth Rs 1,200 crore on October 26. The IPO will close for subscription on October 28, following anchor investor bidding on October 23. This offering is entirely an offer for sale from the Edelweiss Group with no fresh issue component. Additionally, SEC Environmental Technologies Ltd plans to launch its IPO on October 27.

articles.title: Tomato prices crash 65% in a week as drought-hit Nashik farmers face a double blow
articles.desc: Tomato farmers in Nashik are facing a double blow as drought conditions and a supply glut drive down prices at Pimpalgaon APMC. Wholesale rates have fallen nearly 65% in a week to Rs 111 per 20-kg crate, while retail prices have dropped 50% to Rs 20 per kg.

articles.title: Jio IPO all set to open: How can investors maximise allotment chances under Rs 2,500 crore RIL shareholders quota
articles.desc: The much-anticipated Reliance Jio Platforms IPO is launching for public subscription starting October 21, 2023. Shareholders of Reliance Industries can benefit from a Rs 2,500 crore reservation aimed at maximizing their investment opportunities. Those eligible are encouraged to apply in both the shareholder and retail categories. Shares are priced between Rs 1,065 and Rs 1,119, with allotments set for October 26 and listings on October 28.

articles.title: WhatsApp stock tips: Nithin Kamath warns of more pump-and-dump schemes as ED freezes accounts worth Rs 200 crore
articles.desc: In a post on X, formerly Twitter, Kamath said such schemes remain a concern even in 2026, calling them one of the silliest ways for investors to lose money. He also warned that these cases could become more frequent as the market cycle advances, pointing to a rise in alleged pump-and-dump schemes operating through WhatsApp groups and influencers promoting stocks and initial public offerings (IPOs).

articles.title: Japan's 20-year bond yield falls sharply after strongest auction on record
articles.desc: Japan's 20-year government bond yield saw a notable decline following a record demand from its recent auction. This drop marked the lowest yield since early September, driven by investor confidence in the Bank of Japan's interest rate stability. The strong auction signals a cautious sentiment among investors, influenced by recent global developments. Other bond yields mirrored this downward trend, showcasing broader market behaviors.

articles.title: Bank of Japan may raise inflation forecast, stand pat on rates, sources say
articles.desc: The Bank of Japan plans to slightly upgrade its fiscal year 2027 inflation forecasts this month. Interest rates are expected to remain stable at 1.25% during the upcoming policy meeting in late October. While inflation risks are present, there is no immediate urgency for further rate hikes. Recent data indicates that inflationary pressures are not escalating significantly at this time.

articles.title: Yen jumps after JGB auction draws big demand, euro finds relief
articles.desc: The yen experienced a notable rise against the dollar, driven by unprecedented demand for long-term Japanese government bonds. In France, curfews were enacted in response to widespread anti-government protests, which pose challenges for President Emmanuel Macron's administration. Meanwhile, the euro gained momentum alongside a rise in European bond futures amid persistent political uncertainties in France and Italy.

articles.title: Mukul Agrawal portfolio: Ace investor adds 7 new equity stocks in Q2. Do you own any?
articles.desc: 7 stocks he likely added to his secondary market portfolio during the second quarter of FY27. With shareholding disclosures still being released, further changes to his portfolio cannot be ruled out.

articles.title: Tonbo Imaging’s Rs 852 crore IPO subscribed 140x. Check GMP, allotment, other details
articles.desc: The issue received bids for 1,15,86,91,464 shares against 85,26,033 shares on offer. Qualified institutional buyers led the demand, subscribing to their allotted portion 293.56 times. The non-institutional investor category was subscribed 170.94 times, while the retail portion saw 31.06 times subscription.

articles.title: Global Market: China and Hong Kong shares weaken as stable growth eases stimulus bets
articles.desc: China and Hong Kong stocks weakened on Tuesday, joining a broader retreat in the region, after Beijing kept key lending rates unchanged and stronger GDP data dampened

articles.title: New Zealand firm Valocity secures biggest-ever deal on day one of India FTA: PM Luxon
articles.desc: Auckland-based property technology company Valocity has secured the biggest deal in its history on the first day of the India-New Zealand Free Trade Agreement (FTA), New Zealand Prime Minister Christopher Luxon said. Highlighting the agreement's potential to boost business opportunities, Luxon said the trade pact would help New Zealand companies expand overseas while creating jobs and raising incomes at home.

articles.title: How is the US economy really doing under President Trump?
articles.desc: Ahead of the midterms Trump has boasted about the performance of the US economy. BBC Verify looks at inflation, jobs and economic growth in the country.

articles.title: Paras Healthcare secures Rs 652 cr from anchor investors; IPO to open on Oct 21
articles.desc: According to circulars uploaded on exchanges' websites, Paras Healthcare has allotted 94,15,584 equity shares to 39 funds at Rs 693 apiece, aggregating to Rs 652.5 crore.

articles.title: Jio IPO’s GMP rises to 22% as India’s largest ever issue set to open on October 21. Should you subscribe?
articles.desc: The IPO is priced at Rs 1,065-1,119 per share and will open on October 21, closing on October 23. At the upper end of the price band, the grey market premium points to an indicative listing price of Rs 1,364 per share.

articles.title: Korea’s KOSPI crashes another 5% as AI rout deepens; AI bellwether down over 40% from peak
articles.desc: Chip heavyweight SK Hynix Inc. headed for its lowest close since April. Data-center infrastructure company Elice Inc. plunged as much as 32% in its trading debut in Seoul. Both AI bellwethers SK Hynix and Samsung have plunged 35% and 22%, respectively.

articles.title: From ₹228 a GB to ₹7.5: How Mukesh Ambani’s Jio rewired India’s internet and is now seeking a ₹10 lakh crore valuation
articles.desc: The company is now asking investors to value it not merely as a telecom operator, but as a broader technology platform spanning 5G, fixed broadband, cloud, entertainment, enterprise services and artificial intelligence.

articles.title: Jio IPO vs Airtel shares: Which telecom giant offers greater valuation comfort to investors?
articles.desc: The Rs 30,213-crore public offering comprises an entirely fresh issue of 27 crore shares. If completed as planned, it will become India’s largest-ever initial public offering (IPO), surpassing Hyundai Motor India’s record set in 2024.

articles.title: Warren Buffett warned about stock valuations but Berkshire Hathaway is aggressively purchasing stocks
articles.desc: While Buffett criticised the current market scenario, his firm Berkshire Hathaway has been pumping up its investments. The company under CEO Greg Abel has been increasing its stake in Google-parent Alphabet, making it one of Berkshire's five largest common stock holdings, led by iPhone maker Apple. Berkshire more than tripled its stake in Alphabet and purchased over $2.6 billion worth of shares in Delta Air Lines after Abel formally took over as chief executive from Warren Buffett at the start of the year.

articles.title: How Peter Lynch turned Fidelity Magellan Fund’s $18 million into $14 billion in 13 years
articles.desc: Peter Lynch is known for his invaluable stock market lessons. The market expert who built one of the best track records in mutual fund history during his stint as Fidelity Magellan fund manager, wrote the popular book ‘One Up on Wall Street’.

articles.title: India eyes a  $20 billion pot of gold in New Zealand as its trade pact goes live
articles.desc: The free trade agreement between India and New Zealand promises to promote trade and enhance professional movement. While some goods may enjoy duty-free status, a significant rise in merchandise exports might take time. However, New Zealand's engagement in several service sectors holds potential benefits for Indian companies. The agreement also opens up new job opportunities for Indian students and creates pathways for skilled professionals.

articles.title: Global Market: South Korea's Elice shares plunge 28% in market debut as data centre stocks shunned
articles.desc: Elice, which raised 201.1 billion won ($150 million) in its IPO, provides AI cloud services as well as AI-based education and business software and plans to spend most of its IPO proceeds on launching portable modular data centres and related infrastructure.

articles.title: Global Market: Japan's Nikkei falls as higher yields, inflation fears weigh
articles.desc: Japan's Nikkei share average fell on Tuesday, dragged lower by technology stocks as investors weighed rising bond yields and persistent inflation concerns

articles.title: Stock Market Holiday 2026: Is stock market closed today for Dussehra? Check remaining holidays for the year
articles.desc: A total of 16 stock market holidays have been scheduled for 2026, out of which twelve have already passed. After the Dussehra holiday, trading will remain suspended on three more occasions over the remaining two months of the year.

articles.title: Oil Price Today (October 20): Crude oil nears $110 again as fresh attacks outweigh easing Russian sanctions. What are experts saying?
articles.desc: Brent crude futures gained 21 cents, or 0.20, to $109.76 a barrel, while US West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude futures for November delivery, which expire on Tuesday, rose  0.11% to $104 a barrel. Brent had climbed to $110.70 a barrel in the previous session, its highest level since May 20.

articles.title: Dollar and euro drift, yen slips as markets seek direction
articles.desc: The euro was steady at $1.1216, while the British pound rose 0.1% to $1.3308. The Australian dollar was up 0.1% at $0.6986, while its New Zealand counterpart nudged 0.1% higher to $0.5668.

articles.title: Gold slips as investors weigh Fed rate outlook
articles.desc: Gold slipped in early Asian trade on Tuesday as investors awaited the US Federal Reserve policy decision next week for signals on interest rates and the broader outlook for monetary policy.

articles.title: Deadly fire at Canada military base moved a kilometre 'in 30 to 60 seconds'
articles.desc: The blaze that killed four men and injured dozens of others spread with alarming speed, accounts suggest.

articles.title: Global Market Today: Asian stocks decline in break from US chip rally
articles.desc: Losses were led by a more than 2% drop in South Korea’s Kospi Index — a bellwether for artificial intelligence investments — as chip heavyweight SK Hynix Inc. headed for its lowest close since April. Data-center infrastructure company Elice Inc. plunged as much as 32% in its trading debut in Seoul.

articles.title: Oil eases as markets assess potential waiver on Russian energy, Middle East supply risks
articles.desc: Oil prices fell on Tuesday as markets weighed an executive order from US President Donald Trump that waived some sanctions and tariffs tied to Russian energy exports, while attacks on Saudi Arabia and Yemen kept fears of Middle East supply disruptions in view.

articles.title: HFCL Q2 net profit jumps 448% to Rs 394 crore
articles.desc: Net profit surged 448.14% year-on-year to ₹394.22 crore from ₹71.92 crore a year ago, while revenue increased 143.62% to ₹2,541.79 crore from ₹1,043.34 crore. Sequentially, profit increased 60.49% from the previous month, and revenue rose 32.73%.

articles.title: Steelmakers may outperform non-ferrous peers in Q2 as higher volumes support earnings
articles.desc: Non-ferrous companies are expected to see a sequential decline in earnings, with revenue and Ebitda expected to fall 2% and 13%, respectively. The decline in average LME aluminium prices is likely to weigh on their profitability.

articles.title: UltraTech Cement Q2 net profit up 21% in September quarter
articles.desc: A near 14% year-on-year growth in grey cement volumes to 35.94 mt in the domestic market, though, helped UltraTech clock in a near 19% year-on-year growth in consolidated sales to ₹23,295 crore. This also helped the profit before interest, depreciation and tax rise more than 17% to ₹3,832 crore. Consolidated profit for the quarter rose 21% on-year to ₹1,501 crore.

articles.title: ED freezes trading accounts in scam tied to social media
articles.desc: Last week, the ED's Mumbai Zone conducted searches at 29 premises across six cities-Mumbai, Nashik, Ahmedabad, Gandhinagar, Surat and Bhavnagar-under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act (PMLA). The case relates to R M Drip and Sprinklers Systems and R&B Denims, the agency said. According to the ED, the two companies issued more than 35 million shares and convertible warrants through preferential allotments between April 2023 and March 2024. A substantial portion of the funds allegedly came from a small network of connected individuals, firms and lenders, it said.

articles.title: India-NZ FTA in force: Over half of New Zealand’s exports to India now tariff-free, Wellington also eyes Brazil, Canada
articles.desc: New Zealand is working to strengthen trade relations with Brazil and Canada in response to economic uncertainties. The country expects to complete the first New Zealand-Brazil Trade and Investment Dialogue after upcoming elections. A new free trade agreement with India has been implemented, making more than half of exports tariff-free. The agreement will benefit various products, including sheep meat and wool, as well as local businesses.
